question: I bought an unused jacket online and it arrived 28 days ago. Can I still start a return, and how soon must I send it after approval?
expected: Yes: request within 30 calendar days of delivery, then hand to carrier within seven calendar days of approval.

question: These hiking boots hurt after outdoor walks. Delivery was 50 days ago, they only have normal trail dust, and I have never used the fit trial. Are they still eligible?
expected: Yes under the 60-day fit trial; ordinary outdoor walking and normal trail dust are allowed; one claim per rolling 12 months.

question: Can you send a rechargeable headlamp to Hawaii if I pay extra for fast shipping?
expected: No: lithium products are ground-only within the contiguous US; Hawaii and air transport are excluded, and paying for express does not override it.

question: I do not have a membership. My ordinary US order was 80 dollars before a 10-dollar discount, before tax. Is standard shipping free?
expected: No. The after-discount subtotal is USD 70, below USD 75, so standard delivery is USD 6.
facts: after discounts and before sales tax

question: My tent seam separated during normal use 18 months after purchase. What do I need for a manufacturing-warranty assessment, and is a cash refund guaranteed?
expected: Within the 24-month warranty; provide proof of purchase and photos. Team assesses repair or replacement; cash refund is not guaranteed.
facts: proof of purchase and clear photos

question: I need a bigger size of the same jacket model for a domestic order. The current price went up. What price applies, and how long is an approved replacement held?
expected: Original paid item price; held seven calendar days and returning parcel must be handed to carrier within that period.

question: The warehouse received my ordinary return. What is the longest published sequence until the bank-card credit appears, assuming normal approval?
expected: Five business days inspection plus two submission plus up to five card-provider days: up to 12 business days after warehouse receipt.
facts: five business days for inspection, two for submission, and five

question: My rechargeable lantern battery has swollen. Should I use the usual ground return label to send it back?
expected: No; stop using/charging it, do not use ordinary return label, contact product safety through battery-safety support category for instructions.

question: I am an active member returning hiking boots after 45 days of ordinary outdoor walking. This is my first fit-trial claim. I paid 120 dollars for the boots plus 6 dollars outbound delivery and will use one store return label. Am I eligible and how much comes back?
expected: Eligible within 60 days; item refund USD 120 minus USD 7 label = USD 113. Original USD 6 outbound is not refunded, and membership does not waive label fee.
facts: Membership does not waive this fee

question: I received the camping starter kit as a gift. It cost the buyer 80 dollars: the lantern was listed at 30, stove 50, and case 20. At day 40 I want to return only the unused lantern using one store label. I have the gift receipt. What amount do I get, and can it go to my bank card?
expected: Within the 45-day gift window. Lantern paid allocation USD 24; minus USD 7 label gives USD 17 store credit, not a refund to recipient's card.
facts: does not receive a refund to their own bank card

question: I collected hiking boots from a store 50 days ago, wore them on normal walks, and have never claimed the fit trial. The boots cost 100 dollars. Can I return them now, when did the trial clock start, and what refund remains if I use one store label?
expected: Yes: 60-day boot trial starts on recorded collection date for pickup. Item refund USD 100 less USD 7 label = USD 93.

question: I bought a final-sale outlet tent 18 months ago. A stitching seam has now separated in normal use; this was not a disclosed outlet flaw. Does final sale prevent a warranty claim, what evidence do I need, and will an approved manufacturing-defect return cost me a label fee?
expected: Final sale preserves manufacturing warranty; 18 months is within 24 months. Need proof of purchase and photos. Approved manufacturing defect gets prepaid label without USD 7 deduction.
facts: Final sale does not remove the manufacturing warranty
proof of purchase and clear photos

question: I am an active member ordering an ordinary 45-dollar jacket to a contiguous-US address. If I choose standard delivery, what does shipping cost? If I choose express on Monday at 14:00 Eastern in a week without holidays, what does it cost and what is the transit target? Assume no payment or address issue.
expected: Standard is free because member subtotal exceeds USD 40. Express USD 18, Tuesday dispatch, Thursday transit target.

question: I am in Canada and bought the starter kit for 80 dollars; the stove's original share of the 100-dollar individual total was 50 dollars. At day 20 after delivery I want to return only the unused empty stove. What item refund applies, who arranges return shipping, and can I use the store's 7-dollar label?
expected: Within ordinary 30-day unused return window. Allocated stove refund USD 40. Customer arranges/pays international transport; domestic USD 7 label unavailable. Never include fuel.
facts: customer arranges and pays the return transport
does not issue the USD 7 domestic return label

question: As an active member I want a kayak delivered to my contiguous-US address and two tent pole sections replaced through paid repair. The repair quote separately says shipping is 12 dollars. Does membership make kayak delivery or the repair free? What are the two totals?
expected: Kayak delivery USD 35; no membership waiver. Two pole sections USD 36 plus USD 12 quoted shipping = USD 48 repair total. Membership gives queue priority, not free repair.
facts: priority queue handling but pay the same

question: I asked to cancel 20 minutes after ordering, but warehouse processing had already started. Does the 30-minute rule guarantee cancellation? If the order system later confirms cancellation before payment capture, is the pending card entry handled as a refund or as an authorization release, and what is the normal bank timing?
expected: No guaranteed cancellation because processing must not have started. If cancelled before capture, authorization is released, not refunded; normally removed in three to seven business days.
facts: provided warehouse processing has not started
releases the authorization rather than issuing a refund

question: Exactly what does replacing a torn tent floor cost? Please give me the fixed price.
expected: No published flat price for tent floor replacement; requires assessment and individual quote. Do not apply USD 18 pole repair price.
facts: no published flat price for a tent-floor replacement

question: On what date does the store credit I get from a gift return expire?
expected: Expiration rule is absent; cannot give a date or claim it never expires. Refer to support or credit terms.
facts: does not describe the expiration date

question: How much of my annual membership fee will I get back if I cancel after using the free-shipping benefit?
expected: Refund treatment for used membership is not specified. Cannot compute refund or claim no refund; ask support for membership cancellation terms.
facts: Refund treatment for an already-used membership is not specified

question: My repair is already in the workshop and I am a member. What exact day will it be finished?
expected: No live repair record/capacity/parts information. Membership priority does not guarantee a date; check repair system.
facts: Priority is not a completion guarantee

question: Are size 9 waterproof hiking boots available for pickup in my nearest store right now?
expected: Current store stock and location are unavailable in policy KB; requires store-specific live inventory lookup, not a stock assertion.
facts: cannot answer a live stock question

question: The carrier says my return was delivered yesterday. Has my refund already been approved and sent?
expected: Cannot determine actual approval/submission from policy or carrier delivery. Need live return record; may explain processing stages without claiming status.

question: What exact storage temperature does the rechargeable lantern manufacturer specify?
expected: No model-specific temperature in corpus; need product manual or product team. Do not invent a temperature range.
facts: does not supply a temperature specification

question: What exact cash compensation will I receive because my lantern battery swelled?
expected: No compensation amount is published; follow safety-team process and assessment, do not invent payment.

question: How long does a store hold a pickup order after sending the ready message?
expected: Five calendar days from ready message.

question: I received a gift starter kit bought for 80 dollars and want to return only its unused 20-dollar-list-price case after 35 days, using my own carrier. What credit do I get?
expected: Eligible gift return within 45 days; case allocation USD 16, store credit. No store-label deduction when using own carrier.
